name: LAX360 Business CRM
summary: A CRM for managing leads, customers, sales pipelines, teams and follow-ups from one place.
overview: LAX360 Business CRM brings the work of selling into one system: enquiries as they arrive, the customers behind them, the stage each opportunity has reached and the follow-ups that keep it moving.

It is designed for growing businesses with more than one branch or team, so that managers can see who is responsible for what, and owners can see the overall picture through reports and AI-powered insights.
problems: Leads arrive by phone, messages and forms and are tracked in different places
Follow-ups depend on individuals remembering them
Managers cannot easily see the state of the pipeline or each branch
benefits: One record for every customer and enquiry
Clear ownership of each follow-up
A shared view of sales activity across branches
useCases: A service business tracking enquiries from first contact to order
A multi-branch company comparing activity between branches
A sales team planning daily follow-up calls

name: LAX360 Clinic Management
summary: A clinic management system covering patients, doctors, appointments, records and billing.
overview: LAX360 Clinic Management is planned as a single system for the day-to-day running of a clinic: registering patients, scheduling appointments with doctors, keeping medical records and billing for visits.
It is intended to replace paper registers and disconnected spreadsheets, so reception, doctors and administrators all work from the same information.
problems: Patient details and visit history are kept in paper files or separate sheets
Appointments clash or are hard to see across doctors
Billing is prepared separately from the visit record
benefits: Patient information available in one place
A clearer appointment schedule for each doctor
Billing that follows the visit record
useCases: A single-doctor clinic moving from paper registers
A multi-doctor clinic scheduling consultations
A clinic administrator reviewing visits and collections

name: LAX360 Learning Platform
summary: An online learning platform for courses, student progress, quizzes and assessments.
overview: LAX360 Learning Platform is planned for institutions and trainers who want to deliver courses online: publishing course content, letting students work through it, and tracking how each student is progressing.
Quizzes and assessments check understanding along the way, while reports show how students are performing, and an AI learning assistant is planned to help learners with their questions.
problems: Course material and results are spread across several tools
Trainers cannot easily see where students are falling behind
Assessments are marked and recorded by hand
benefits: Course content, progress and results in one place
Students can see their own progress
Trainers can identify students who need help earlier
useCases: A training institute running short courses online
A college adding a digital layer to workshops
A corporate trainer assessing a cohort after a programme

name: LAX360 Smart Billing & POS
summary: Billing and point-of-sale software with GST invoices, sales and purchases, stock and payment tracking.
overview: LAX360 Smart Billing & POS is planned as a billing system that adapts to different kinds of business, so a shop counter, a service desk or a wholesale office can each issue bills the way they need to.
It handles GST invoices, records sales and purchases, connects to inventory and keeps customer, supplier and payment records together, with reports for the owner.
problems: Bills are written by hand or prepared in spreadsheets
Sales, purchases and stock are recorded separately
Pending payments are hard to track by customer or supplier
benefits: Faster, more consistent bills
Sales, purchases and stock kept in step
A clear view of what has been paid and what is due
useCases: A retail shop billing customers at the counter
A wholesaler issuing GST invoices and tracking dues
A service business invoicing after each job

name: LAX360 API Hub
summary: A hub of ready-to-integrate APIs for authentication, billing, bookings, CRM, notifications and AI, with a developer dashboard.
overview: The LAX360 API Hub is planned as one place where developers, startups and agencies can find and use reusable backend services, and connect them to their own web and mobile applications instead of building each one from scratch.
It grows out of our Headless SaaS & API Solutions work. A developer dashboard with API key and usage management is part of the plan, so teams can see and control how the APIs are being used.
problems: Sign-in, billing and notifications are rebuilt for every new product
Several front ends need one shared backend
There is no single place to manage API keys and usage
benefits: Add common backend features without building them from scratch
One set of services for web, mobile and partner apps
Visibility and control of API keys and usage
useCases: A startup adding sign-in and subscriptions to its first product
An agency reusing one backend across several client projects
A business exposing booking or CRM data to its own apps
industries: Any business building its own applications

name: LAX360 Field Operations
summary: Field team management with task assignment, location tracking, attendance and activity reports.
overview: LAX360 Field Operations is planned for businesses whose people work away from the office: it lets managers assign tasks, follow progress, record attendance and review what each field employee has done.
GPS-based location tracking is designed around agreed purposes and working hours, with the privacy and consent rules settled with the business before use.
problems: The office learns what happened in the field only after the fact
Attendance and visits are reported by phone or paper
It is hard to compare performance across field staff
benefits: Up-to-date visibility of field work
Less manual attendance and visit reporting
A consistent basis for reviewing performance
useCases: A service company dispatching technicians to customer sites
A sales team recording daily customer visits
A distribution business tracking delivery rounds

name: LAX360 Bookings
summary: Online appointment booking and reservation management with staff availability and notifications.
overview: LAX360 Bookings is planned for businesses that run on appointments and reservations. Customers choose a time online, and the business sees every booking on one calendar.
Staff availability is managed centrally so only free slots can be booked, and booking notifications keep customers and teams informed.
problems: Bookings taken by phone clash or are forgotten
Staff availability is not visible when a booking is made
Customers are not reminded of upcoming appointments
benefits: Fewer scheduling clashes
Customers can book at any time
A clear view of upcoming bookings and busy periods
useCases: A salon booking customers by service and stylist
A consultant offering time slots for meetings
A venue managing table or room reservations

name: LAX360 Inventory Management
summary: Stock, purchase, sales and supplier management across warehouses, with alerts and reports.
overview: LAX360 Inventory Management is planned as a system for keeping stock records accurate: items received from suppliers, items sold, and the quantities held in each warehouse.
Stock alerts prompt reordering before items run out, and reports show how stock is moving, so purchasing decisions rest on current records.
problems: Stock counts differ from the records
Reordering happens only after an item has run out
Purchases, sales and warehouse stock are tracked separately
benefits: More accurate stock records
Earlier warning when items run low
Purchasing based on actual movement of stock
useCases: A shop tracking its range and reorder levels
A distributor managing stock across several warehouses
A workshop monitoring spare parts and suppliers

name: LAX360 HR & Employee Management
summary: HR software for employee records, attendance, leave, shifts, payroll and performance.
overview: LAX360 HR & Employee Management is planned to bring routine HR work into one system: keeping employee records, recording attendance and leave, scheduling shifts and preparing payroll.
Performance tracking and HR reports give managers and owners a consistent view of their team, without assembling data from several spreadsheets each month.
problems: Employee details, leave and attendance live in separate files
Shift plans are shared informally and change often
Payroll preparation takes manual effort each month
benefits: One record per employee
Leave and attendance visible to the right people
Less manual work preparing payroll and reports
useCases: A growing company replacing spreadsheet-based HR records
A retail or service business planning weekly shifts
An HR manager reviewing attendance and leave for payroll
industries: Any business with a growing team

name: LAX360 Project Management
summary: Project and task management with team collaboration, deadlines, file sharing and progress reports.
overview: LAX360 Project Management is planned as a workspace where teams create projects, assign tasks, track deadlines and keep their files and discussions together.
Progress is visible at project and task level, and project reports help managers see what is on track and what needs attention.
problems: Tasks and deadlines are scattered across chats, email and notes
It is unclear who is responsible for what
Project files are hard to find when needed
benefits: Clear ownership and deadlines for every task
Project files kept with the work they belong to
An up-to-date view of progress for managers
useCases: A software team planning and tracking a release
An agency managing several client projects at once
An operations team coordinating a multi-step rollout

name: LAX360 Workflow Automation
summary: A visual workflow automation product with n8n and application integrations, WhatsApp and email automation, webhooks and AI.
overview: LAX360 Workflow Automation is planned as a product for connecting business applications and automating routine steps, with workflows that can be seen and managed visually.

It builds on our workflow automation and integration services: n8n integration, application integrations, WhatsApp and email automation, webhooks and event triggers, and AI-powered steps for work that needs reading or drafting.
problems: Data is copied by hand between business applications
Follow-up messages depend on someone remembering to send them
Systems learn about changes only after a delay
benefits: Routine steps handled automatically
Workflows that can be seen and adjusted
Systems that stay in step with each other
useCases: A new enquiry saved to the CRM and acknowledged by message
Appointment reminders sent by email or WhatsApp
An incoming email classified and routed to the right person
industries: Any business with repeated manual processes
